name: Obsoletion
source:
A thousand leagues beneath the ocean of a foreign planet, you find yourself trapped inside a ship with something humanity has never seen before. It was only meant to be a short trip. How could it have ended this way? 

You're the only one left. You know what you have to do.

Only one question remains - can you do it before the server shuts down?

[From [url=https://rubyring-games.itch.io/obsoletion]itch.io[/url]]
